CHEMISTRY — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Types of detergents ● Preparation of detergents ● Mode of action of.

   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

   C. Removing all vegetation
